author: jdlang
body:
#### PR description:

These changes enable Pythia to use photon flux settings with externally-produced partons. This is needed for official MC generation of photonuclear events using HELAC-Onia.

**Pythia8Hadronizer.cc**  
Copied the block for checking and applying photon flux settings over to the initializer for external partons. The existing block in the initializer for internal partons is linked below:
https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/ed8eb2de33cdc8e9073d406e3a4b9c6481883cc2/GeneratorInterface/Pythia8Interface/plugins/Pythia8Hadronizer.cc#L503-L515

In addition, this requires the changes made to LHAupLesHouches.cc in PR 51281: https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51281

These changes will ultimately need to be backported to CMSSW_14_1_X for simulation of 2023 PbPb HIForward data.

#### PR validation:

These changes (both the modification to Pythia8Hadronizer.cc and the modifications from #51281) have been tested privately with CMSSW_14_1_9_patch3 for MC GEN-SIM with HELAC-Onia producing LHE files fed into Pythia8 using the existing CMSSW LHEInterface.
